## 01 — Arc Orb

Design an original, flat corporate logo for “Dataorb Cloud”, a company providing GPU compute sourcing, supplier coordination and AI infrastructure deployment support. Explore an abstract Orb made of only three short, confidently drawn arcs. Suggest connection and an open circular form without drawing a physical planet, complex spherical grid, cloud icon or network mesh. Use balanced optical spacing and robust stroke thickness that survives 16 px reproduction. Pair the symbol with a carefully spaced, restrained contemporary sans-serif wordmark reading exactly “Dataorb Cloud”. Primary colors: deep navy #0C2633 and teal #007F76. Also create pure black and pure white versions that require no color separation. Prepare a clean comparison board on a white editorial canvas showing: a large logo on white, reversed logo on deep navy, a realistic minimalist website navigation application, and isolated favicon previews at 16, 24 and 32 pixels, plus a black-and-white strip. Label it “01 / Arc Orb”. Show the exact same mark consistently in every application. Use generous clear space. Reference the restraint, type hierarchy and navigation-scale clarity of Equinix, Digital Realty, CoreWeave and Lambda, but do not copy or imitate their marks, letterforms or distinctive arrangements. Do not resemble NVIDIA’s eye or spiral. No gradients, glow, neon, 3D, shadows, texture, stock mockup objects, certifications, partner badges, or generic cloud icons. Deliver the actual supported raster format at high resolution; do not claim it is vector or put a bitmap inside SVG.

## 02 — Negative-space D

Design an original, minimal corporate logo for “Dataorb Cloud”, a GPU compute sourcing and AI infrastructure deployment support company. Create a compact circular silhouette with a clear capital D formed by intentional negative space inside the circle. Favor one solid shape and one simple counter, with an optically balanced vertical stem and rounded bowl. The D must remain immediately legible at favicon sizes, using generous negative space rather than tiny gaps. Pair the symbol with the exact words “Dataorb Cloud” in a refined, neutral contemporary sans-serif. Primary colors: deep navy #0C2633 and teal #007F76. Supply pure black and pure white alternatives with identical geometry. Build one clean comparison board with: logo on white, reversed logo on deep navy, logo in a minimalist website navigation bar, isolated 16, 24 and 32 pixel favicon applications, and black-and-white versions. Label it “02 / Negative-space D”. Keep each application geometrically consistent and allow generous clear space. Use Equinix, Digital Realty, CoreWeave and Lambda only as references for restraint, typography proportions and practical logo application, never as sources for copied symbols or distinctive layouts. Avoid NVIDIA’s eye, spiral shapes resembling an eye, Digital Realty’s segmented corner motif, generic cloud icons, complex globe grids, gradients, glow, neon, 3D or shadows. This is a concept board, not a brand-affiliation statement. Return the true supported file format; raster output must be labeled raster and never described as vector SVG.

## 03 — Signature O wordmark

Design an original wordmark-only identity reading exactly “Dataorb Cloud” for a business that helps enterprise AI teams and researchers source GPU compute and coordinate deployment. Use carefully spaced contemporary sans-serif lettering with a distinctive custom O in “Dataorb” as the sole identifying gesture. Keep the other letters highly readable and quiet. Explore a simple open circular O with a precise, subtle cut that signals openness and connection without looking like a power button or Q. No separate standalone symbol beside the wordmark. For favicon applications only, extract this same custom O, preserving its exact geometry at 16, 24 and 32 pixels. Primary colors: deep navy #0C2633, teal #007F76, white #FFFFFF. Include true black and white monochrome alternatives. Present a clean comparison board labeled “03 / Signature O” showing: large wordmark on white, reversed wordmark on deep navy, a website navigation bar with the wordmark at a realistic small size, the three favicon sizes, and a monochrome strip. Keep all samples consistent, flat and spacious. Reference the restrained corporate clarity and scale relationships of Equinix, Digital Realty, CoreWeave and Lambda without copying their logos, letterforms or arrangements. Do not use NVIDIA-like eyes, swirls, cloud icons, intricate globe grids, glow, gradients, 3D, decorative texture, extra taglines, certifications or fake partners. Return the native supported output format and identify it accurately. Raster concepts are not vector artwork; do not wrap a raster image in SVG and label it vector.

## Combining the three externally generated concepts

After generating the three directions, place them in equal-width columns on one 1440 × 1140 comparison canvas. Keep the same row heights: direction name, white background, navy background, navigation, favicon sizes, monochrome strip. Preserve each chosen mark exactly; do not regenerate or blend their geometry while compositing. The local `comparison.svg` illustrates this layout using original hand-authored vector studies.
